name: JUFA Wipptal
beschreibung: The JUFA Wipptal is located in the municipality of Steinach am Brenner, directly in the Wipptal in Tirol. The hotel is modernly furnished and conveys a matter-of-fact, functional atmosphere aimed at families and active guests. Typical amenities include spacious rooms, a wellness area with sauna, and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. Hiking trails and cross-country ski trails are directly accessible from the accommodation, making it suitable for nature lovers. Guests can expect an uncomplicated stay here, characterized by the quiet location at the entrance to the village and the proximity to the motorway. The hotel also provides conference rooms, so it can also be used for events.
